chapter_description.p: The Error Manager module provides the mechanisms for handling errors and warnings in Nelson.
It defines how exceptions are created, raised, and rethrown, as well as how diagnostic information can be retrieved after an error or warning occurs.
It lets programs control execution after failures, capture diagnostic reports, and display warnings without stopping execution.
It provides the common error and warning primitives used by Nelson code.

keyword.name: MException.last
keyword.description: Return or reset last uncaught MException.

keyword.name: getLastReport
keyword.description: Returns last recorded formatted error message.

keyword.name: lasterr
keyword.description: Returns or sets last recorded error message.

keyword.name: nelson.lang.correction.ConvertToFunctionNotationCorrection

keyword.name: nelson.lang.correction.ReplaceIdentifierCorrection

keyword.name: throwAsCaller
keyword.description: Throw exception as if occurs within calling function.
